jules_pm: Quick check-in on private deploy v1 roll criteria. Two field asks surfaced: explicit preflight failure messages (actionable) and an opt-in auto-upgrade notification flow. want to confirm owners and acceptable SLAs.

sam_engineer: For preflight we can fail fast and return a single-line remediation message for each check. example: 
- "CNI mismatch: supported versions x.y - x.z. Run: upgrade-cni --recommended"
We should keep each check <200ms locally to avoid long CLI waits.

ara_field: Customers consistently say the upgrade notification must be human-readable and include ETA, rollback plan, and an easy opt-out. they also want a visible banner in their console when a new operator version is available.

becky_sre: SLA idea: we require that in-canary upgrades (2 beta sites) succeed with no >5% error increase and no more than 15 minutes of operator-unavailability during migration. For field rollouts we define a 2-week validation window before GA.

jules_pm: Owners: sam = preflight checks + error messages, becky = canary validation metrics + rollback playbook, ara = customer comms + console banner copy. timeline: prototype preflight and banner by next Tues; canary metric dashboards by next Fri.

sam_engineer: Implementation note: preflight will run locally in the installer and also as a `kubectl` job during operator bootstrap. checks: outbound connectivity test, required ports, k8s version, disk, CNI plugin check, ip-preservation probe. we'll surface remediation commands like \`kubectl patch network-attachment ...\`.

ara_field: Regarding auto-upgrade toggle: must be opt-in by default = false. customers want a scheduled maintenance window that triggers auto-upgrade. include a webhook callback so they can approve programmatically.

becky_sre: Rollback playbook must guarantee KV snapshotting before any upgrade step. snippet idea in runbook: 
```
# before upgrade
redwoodctl snapshot --target s3://customer-backups/rw-$(date +%s).tar
# promote snapshot retention tagging
```
We should also provide a mitigation path for egress IP drift: probe immediately after upgrade and, if drift detected, run a reconciliation job that reassigns LB IPs.

ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket RW-PRIV-901: "preflight UX + upgrade-notify + opt-in auto-upgrade" assigned to private-packaging squad.

jules_pm: Risk callouts: customers behind strict proxies may fail outbound checks. mitigation: add "proxy-config" installer flag and document how to allowlist our domains. Also some airgapped installs will reject snapshots; provide an offline snapshot export option.

sam_engineer: For airgap we ship a `snap export` and `snap import` flow that writes to a tarball. make sure it is incremental-friendly so large customer data doesn't block upgrades.

ara_field: Field asks: add a short compatibility matrix in the installer UI linking to supported kernel versions and CNIs. customers appreciate an easy-pass/fail color indicator.

becky_sre: Testing: need automated network regression tests in CI that spin up a tiny k8s cluster, apply CNI variants, simulate egress-ip persistance, and perform an operator upgrade + rollback. add this to gating CI.

jules_pm: Action items recap: sam = preflight prototype + CLI output examples (due Tue); becky = canary dashboards + rollback checklist (due Fri); ara = customer banner copy + opt-in webhook spec (due Tue); sam+becky = define probe for egress-ip reconciliation. i'll update the roadmap doc and tag the epic as "launch-gates: preflight, canary, comms".

ara_field: I'll line up two beta customers for the canary and confirm maintenance windows. target first canary next month.

jules_pm: Thanks team. small ask: keep error messages short and give one concrete next step. examples we can reuse: 
- "Missing outbound: allow *.redwood-inference.net:443 or set --proxy"
- "Disk low (<5%): increase PV or set dataRetention low"

ops-bot: REMINDER: weekly private-packaging sync in #product-private every Wed 10am.
